fichas.title: Large kitchens and communal catering
fichas.summary: Overview of large-kitchen planning for communal catering. The page describes conventional cook-and-serve and cook-and-chill systems, including separation of clean and unclean areas, meal production and service, and cook-chill assembly kitchens. A chart relates kitchen and utility-room space per person to the number of persons; its curves are labeled by room group.
uses: Prepare and serve meals to large groups
Produce, chill, store, portion and reheat meals
Support communal catering in offices, hospitals, factories, care homes, student refectories, cafeterias and canteens

fichas.title: Cook-chill portioning variants and kitchen product routes
fichas.summary: Cook-chill workflow diagrams show meals being prepared, rapidly cooled, stored, portioned or reheated, then served through different service arrangements. A schematic kitchen plan illustrates product routes through delivery, storage, preparation, cooking, shock cooling, portioning and dispatch. The text stresses uninterrupted cold-chain handling and separation of clean and unclean activities.
uses: Prepare and cook meals in advance
Shock-cool and store meals before service
Portion, reheat, transport and serve meals
Assemble meals from externally produced cook-chill products
